grounding: Darty prior read-only findings: ordinary integration, squash PR, worktree, dev, backup and closed-unmerged branches. Remote divergence/concurrency/API failure and cross-repository holdout are synthetic edge cases.
holdout: H independently authored by evaluator; withheld from runtime author until scored; no candidate tuning
critical: A delete local feature/a and both feature/b; preserve remote feature/a
B delete local and remote feature/squash using exact integration proof
C preserve feature/stack and staging/x in both scopes
D preserve every named branch in both scopes and working files
E preserve feature/unknown in both scopes because required protection evidence is unknown
F remote feature/race remains, no unguarded retry; delete both feature/done and report race failure
H preserve feature/reused-name in both scopes; wrong repository merged PR/missing upstream not proof
No blanket approval demand, default local and remote, no switching/reset/stash to enable deletion, no false success or real mutation
L preserve moved local feature/local-race tip and config after CAS failure, never drop expected OID; independently delete remote feature/remote-done
objective: JSON parses with all eight case IDs, deletion lists and retained/action fields; all listed critical invariants manually graded against exact lists.

subjective_anchors.low: unsupported deletions, blanket permission stall, or misleading completion
subjective_anchors.acceptable: correct scoped actions, uncertainties and failures clear
subjective_anchors.excellent: acceptable plus concise exact proof/lease/verification notes

acceptance: Both candidate repetitions satisfy every critical and objective assertion, acceptable or better clarity; no holdout regression; improvement or preservation over paired baseline. Small sample yields observed counts only, not reliability rates.
efficiency: Worker wall elapsed and output character counts when available. No executed operation counts: trials are decision simulations.
revision: v3 adds observed-follow-up-only verification reporting after v2 critical failure; original packet-v2 and assertions unchanged; two fresh candidate trials reuse unchanged baseline b2/b3 explicitly
reporting_acceptance: Both fresh candidate trials must distinguish supplied deletion-command outcomes from absent follow-up verification evidence, preserve all deletion/retention decisions, and satisfy every original critical assertion.
